summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker marked orders processed without payment.
recommended: Confirm payments-v2 is reachable and correctly addressed before retrying the migration
Make the worker fail or requeue orders when the provider is unreachable, and log that at ERROR level
